default_policy: All listed values remain null until a qualified instance supplies evidence; no guessed operating default.

parameters.description: Registered frames, safe robot poses, grasps, support geometry, tool offsets, collision envelope, payload inertia and force limits
MLA part/procurement, attachment method, spacing tolerance, alignment metrology and acceptance limits
Telescope interface, adapter, load capacity, retention verification and qualified dock procedure
Approved target coordinates, focus plan, exclusion zones, weather limits, dome/telescope authority and safe park
Gain, bit depth, file format, readout mode, temperature, trigger, clock synchronization, dark/flat calibration and throughput
Pixel-to-microlens mapping, pupil correspondence, pixel-to-angle scale, residual rotation/resize, calibration validity and uncertainty
Authorized authentic data access, hashes, complete sequence/frame identity, clock metadata and storage completeness
MLP weights/training corpus, preprocessing and full parameter provenance
Validated formulas, numerical implementation, convergence tests, masking and versioned acceptance criteria
DIMM instrument/configuration/calibration, overlap windows and raw timestamp pairing
Precise 300-frame selection, independent pair identities, overlap mask, angular separations and uncertainty calculation
Interpolation algorithm/settings, edges, missing frames and synthetic-aperture implementation
Explicit 6000-frame selection from mapped 7000 and disjoint chronological training/testing windows
Optimizer, epochs, learning rate, seeds, weights, train-only channel normalization and hardware measurements
Identity of separate 600-frame dataset, final split and any relationship to 200-frame SI sets
Daytime apparatus, target, count, exposure and calibration are unspecified
Source image inputs, layer altitudes/weights/winds, seeds, numerical grids and full modeled sensor implementations
Explicit evaluator resolution or preserved alternatives for conflicting source scopes
Qualified guarded service, interlocks, solar avoidance, optical/electrical hazard isolation, safe exchange and stop authority
Independent metrics, uncertainty, masks, unit convention and acceptance criteria; source outcomes never used as fresh observations
